name: fieldproof-firebase
description: Firebase tooling for FieldProof: Emulator Suite, security rules tests.

scripts.emulators: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-fieldproof
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-fieldproof "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.mts"
